operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to launch into the enterprise market.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just came back from a customer call. It really shifted my perspective on the next launch.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh? What came up in the conversation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We were originally on track for enterprise, but these smaller businesses are living the problem every day. They're actually excited to try something new.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: So you're reconsidering the target segment? What made you decide to go that way?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It's the customer feedback, honestly. They kept saying they don't need a huge integration, just a simple tool that works. That hit home for me.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Are you updating the go-to-market strategy to reflect that shift?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Already done. The new SMB launch plan is sitting in the go-to-market doc. I can share it with you if you want to review.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great, I'd be happy to take a look. Send it over whenever you're ready.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier enterprise launch plan and retain the current SMB plan and its rationale.
